segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רעו
אֲכִילַת שַׁבָּת אֵינָהּ בִּשְׁבִיל שְׂבִיעָה כְּלָל, רַק בְּגִין דְּיִתְבָּרְכוּן מִנֵּהּ כָּל שִׁתָּא יוֹמִין:
segments.en: There are those who say Torah that is very broad below — greatly expanding the matter and magnifying it greatly. But above — it is very brief. For above in holiness — only some spark of it remains. But there is the opposite. For the true Tzadikim say Torah that appears brief below — but above — it is very very broad and great. Fortunate are they.
